title: Fenton Work-Order Generator
description: Multi-agent Fenton mining, step 3: reads the full text, identifies subfigures whose data are worth extracting, decides needs_xy_extraction per subfigure (written inside each subfigure; never at figure level), and produces 01_work_order.json. The category table and work-order format are inlined in system.md with no skills attached. Read-only; the main agent writes.
